justification: The assessment’s XOR construction gives exactly the reference joint distribution. Both (X,Y) and (X,Z) are uniform on the four bit pairs, establishing the hypotheses. Yet P(X=0,Y=0,Z=0)=1/4 differs from P(X=0)P(Y=0,Z=0)=1/8, refuting joint independence. Also, P(X=0 | Y+Z=0)=1 differs from 1/2.
